senses.gloss:
a. 
(-या, -यी f.) [शी-अच्] Lying down, sleep ing (usually at the end of comp.); रात्रिजागरपरो दिवाशयः [[R. 19. 34]]; so उत्तानशय, पार्श्वशय, वृक्षेशय, बिलेशय &c. 
-यः 
__1 Sleep. 
__2 A bed, couch; मायाशये शयाना मे नाद्यापि पुनरुत्थिताः [[Bhāg. 10. 13. 41.]] 
__3 A hand; सुन्दरीभिः शयाम्भोजसंवाहितपदं पुनः [[Śiva B. 2. 91]]; तदूरुकाण्डे सविलासमर्पितः शयः शयानेन सहानयामुना [[Rām. Ch. 2. 49]]; also used as a measure of length. 
__4 A snake, especially the boa. 
__5 Abuse, imprecation, curse. 
__6 A stake.

[शी आधारे क्यप्] 
__1 A bed, couch; शय्या भूमितलम् [[Śānti. 4. 9]]; मही रम्या शय्या [[Bh. 3. 79]]; [[R. 5. 66.]] 
__2 Sleeping. 
__3 Tying, stringing together. 
-Comp. 
-अध्यक्षः, -पालः the superintendent or guardian of a king's bed-chamber. 
-अन्तः a sleeping place; शय्यान्ते कुलमलिनां क्षणं विलीनम् [[Ki. 7. 31.]] 
-उत्थायम् ind. early in the morning. 
-उत्सङ्गः the side of a bed. 
-गत a. 
__1 lying in a bed. 
__2 confined to a bed. 
-गृहम् a bedchamber; अथार्धरात्रे स्तिमितप्रदीपे शय्यागृहे सुप्तजने प्रबुद्धः [[R. 16. 4.]]
a. Sleepy, sleeping.

__1 One who sleeps much. 
__2 The moon.

a. [शी-अथच् [[Uṇ. 3. 112]]] Sleepy, asleep. 
-थः 
__1 Death. 
__2 A kind of snake, the boa-constrictor. 
__3 A boar. 
__4 A fish. 
__5 (Ved.) A lair, abode.

[शी-ल्युट्] 
__1 Sleeping, sleep, lying down. 
__2 A bed, couch; शयनस्थो न भुञ्जीत [[Ms. 4. 74]]; [[R. 1. 95]]; [[V. 3. 10.]] 
__3 Copulation, sexual union. 
-Comp. 
-अ [Page1535-2] (आ) गारः, -रम्, -गृहम् a bed-chamber, sleeping apartments. 
-एकादशी the eleventh day of the bright half of Āṣāḍha when Viṣṇu lies down to enjoy his four months' repose. 
-तलगत a. gone to bed, lying in bed. 
-पालिका the (female) keeper of a (royal) bed. 
-भूमिः a bed-chamber. 
-रचनम् the preparation of a bed (one of the 64 arts). 
-वासस् n. sleeping garment. 
-सखी a bed-fellow. 
-स्थ a. being on a couch; शयनस्थो न भुञ्जीत [[Ms. 4. 74.]] 
-स्थानम् a sleeping apartment, bed-chamber.
The longitude of a planet reckoned from the vernal equinoctial point.

[शी-आधारे अनीयर्] 
__1 A bed, couch; परिशून्यं शयनीयमद्य मे [[R. 8. 66]]; कान्तासखस्य शयनीयशिलातलं ते [[U. 3. 21]]; (शयनीयकम् in the same sense). 
__2 A bedchamber; शयनीयं नरेन्द्रस्य तदासाद्य व्यतिष्ठत [[Rām. 2. 15. 20.]]

शयानः,
 
-शयानकः 
__1 A chameleon. 
__2 A kind of snake, the boa.

a. [शी-आलुच्] Sleepy, slothful; हन्ति नोपशयस्थोऽपि शयालुर्मृगयुर्मृगान् [[Śi. 2. 80.]] 
-लुः 
__1 A kind of snake, the boa-constrictor. 
__2 A dog. 
__3 A jackal.

p. p. [शी कर्तरि क्त] 
__1 Sleeping, reposed, asleep. 
__2 Lying down. 
-तम् 
__1 Sleep, sleeping. 
__2 The place where one has slept.

शयुः,
शयुनः [शी-उः उनन् [[Uṇ. 1. 7]]; 3. 60] A large snake, the boa.
Lying, sleeping.

[सो-घञ्] 
__1 End, close, termination. 
__2 Close of day, evening. 
__3 An arrow, a missile. (साये ‘in the evening, at the close of the day’.) 
-Comp. 
-अशनम् an evening meal. 
-अहन् m. (forming सायाह्नः) evening, evening time; सायाहनि प्रणयिनो भवनं व्रजन्त्याश्चेतो न कस्य हरते गतिरङ्गनायाः [[Bv. 2. 157.]] 
-आरम्भ a. beginning in the evening. 
-धूर्तः 
__1 a rogue, a cheat or deceiver in the form of evening. 
__2 The moon; आदत्त दीप्रं मणिमम्बरस्य दत्त्वा यदस्मै खलु सायधूर्तः [[N. 22. 52.]] 
-मण्डनम् sunset.

__1 Repose, sleep. 
__2 The state of lying or reposing; कुर्यात्तृणमयं चापं शयीत मृगशायिकाम् [[Mb. 1. 140. 13]]; also शायिता.

f. 
__1 Position in due order ( = क्रमस्थितिः). 
__2 A dagger.
a. Reclining, sleeping, resting &c.
m. A horseman.

__1 An arrow. 
__2 A sword; cf. सायक.

[सो-ण्वुल्] 
__1 An arrow; तत् साधुकृतसंधानं प्रतिसंहर सायकम् [[Ś. 1. 11.]] 
__2 A sword. 
__3 The number ‘five’. 
__4 The latitude of the sky. 
-Comp. 
-पुङ्खः the feathered part of an arrow; सक्ताङ्गुलिः सायकपुङ्ख एव [[R. 2. 31.]]
€1Ā. (सयते) To go, move.
a. Dyed with lac; [[Ki.]]
a. A companion, comrade; द्वा सुपर्णा सयुजा सखाया समानं वृक्षं परिषस्वजाते [[Muṇḍ. 3. 1. 1.]]
One of the same flock or tribe.
Junction, union; यस्मात् प्रियाप्रियवियोगसयोगजन्मशोकाग्निना सकलयोनिषु दह्यमानः । [[Bhāg. 7. 9. 17.]]

a. 
__1 Having the same womb, uterine. 
__2 Closely related to. 
__3 Closely united with the womb. 
-निः 
__1 A whole or uterine brother. 
__2 A pair of nippers for cutting betel-nut. 
__3 N. of Indra.

a. 
__1 Attended by women. 
__2 Along with the women.

a. 
(-नी f.) Belonging to the evening, evening; सायंतने सबनकर्मणि संप्रवृत्ते [[Ś. 3. 27]]; अलिनारमतालिनी शिलीन्ध्रे सह सायंतनदीपपाटलाभे [[Śi. 6. 72.]] 
-Comp. 
-मल्लिका evening jasmine. 
-समयः eventide.

ind. In the evening; प्रयता प्रातरन्बेतु सायं प्रत्युद्व्रजेदपि [[R. 1. 90]], 48. 
-Comp. 
-कालः evening. 
-धृतिः f. the evening oblation. 
-प्रातर् ind. in the evening and morning. 
-भोजनम् an evening meal; [[Kull.]] on [[Ms. 3. 105.]] 
-मण्डनम् 
__1 sunset. 
__2 the sun. 
-संध्या 
__1 the [Page1673-1] evening twilight. 
__2 the evening prayer. 
__3 the goddess to be worshipped in the evening. °देवता N. of Sarasvatī.
N. of a very learned Brāhmaṇa and a Vedic commentator, supposed to have flourished about 1370 A. D.

__1 Intimate union, identification, absorption, especially into a deity (one of the four states of Mukti); सायुज्यं सलोकतां जयति य एवमेतत् साम वेद [[Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 22.]] 
__2 Similarity, likeness.

a. Armed. 
-Comp. 
-प्रग्रह a. holding weapons in the hands.
